wpilib.name: WPILib documentation (frc-docs)
wpilib.index: objects.inv (Sphinx inventory; the sitemap.xml only lists version roots)
wpilib.robots: https://docs.wpilib.org/robots.txt: User-agent: * Disallow: (empty) = allow everything. Sitemap lists only /en/stable/ and /en/latest/ roots.
wpilib.license: CC BY 4.0. Footer on every page: 'Copyright 2026, FIRST and other WPILib Contributors. This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.' Repo license: https://github.com/wpilibsuite/wpilib-docs/blob/main/license.txt

vivid.name: Vivid-Hosting VH-109 FRC radio docs
vivid.index: https://frc-radio.vivid-hosting.net/sitemap-pages.xml (35 pages). The /tuerkce/ sitemap is the Turkish mirror and is skipped.
vivid.robots: Allow: / for all agents. Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes.
vivid.license: No license or copyright statement found on the site (GitBook). Compliance page at /miscellaneous/compliance is regulatory (FCC/IC/CE), not a content license.

rev.name: REV Robotics documentation
rev.index: https://docs.revrobotics.com/sitemap.xml is a sitemap index; one sitemap-pages.xml per GitBook space.
rev.robots: Allow: / for all agents. Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes.
rev.license: No license statement on docs.revrobotics.com. Site footer only says 'REV Robotics'. https://www.revrobotics.com/terms-conditions/ are sales terms with no clause about documentation or automated access.

ctre.name: CTR Electronics Phoenix 6 documentation
ctre.aliases: pro.docs.ctr-electronics.com serves the same Sphinx project (its sitemap points at v6.docs URLs), so it is not crawled separately.
ctre.index: objects.inv (Sphinx inventory, 113 docs); sitemap.xml only lists version roots.
ctre.license: Footer: 'Copyright 2026, CTR Electronics'. No license file in https://github.com/CrossTheRoadElec/Phoenix6-Documentation and no license statement on the site.

ni.name: NI Knowledge Base (roboRIO articles)
ni.index: No crawlable index of roboRIO articles. Fixed list of verified article IDs in fetch-ni.ts plus one hop of linked articles whose title mentions roboRIO or FRC.
ni.robots: https://knowledge.ni.com/robots.txt: Allow: / for all agents (only /secur/forgotpassword.jsp disallowed).
ni.tls: The server omits the DigiCert Global G2 TLS RSA SHA256 2020 CA1 intermediate, so fetch.ts passes that public intermediate (lib/certs/) as an extra CA for this host.
ni.license: Terms of use restrict content: 'NI authorizes you to view and download the materials at this Web site only for your personal, non-commercial use ... (b) you may not modify the materials ... or reproduce or publicly display, perform, or distribute or otherwise use them for any public or commercial purpose; and (c) you may not use any of these materials on any other Web site or networked computer environment for any purpose.'
ni.why_disabled: Clause (c) forbids storing NI KB text in another networked environment. robots.txt allows crawling, the terms do not allow reuse. The fetcher exists and works; run it only with an explicit `--only ni` after deciding the terms question.
scope: fixed list of roboRIO / FRC article IDs, verified live at run time
